# SCP-096 "The Shy Guy"
This guide explains what the object is in the context of the game and its mechanics. It does NOT cover the object's "lore" aspects.
This page serves as a compilation of links to other, more detailed guides regarding the object, as well as a brief overview of the section.
## Round Start
At the starting point — at the beginning of the round or immediately after spawning — SCP-096 is located within its containment chamber. The containment chamber acts as a containment measure designed to prevent harm to facility personnel.
As long as the object remains inside, it poses virtually no threat.
- Facility Personnel Objective: Contain the object within the containment chamber. - SCP-096 Objective: Escape the containment chamber.
[textlink="Learn more about containment here." link="Scp096Containment"]
[textlink="Learn more about methods to escape here." link="Scp096ContainmentBreach"]
## States
States define a set of mechanics and determine the object's behavior. During a round, the object will transition into different states depending on the actions of those around it or 096's own actions.
[textlink="Learn more about states here." link="Scp096States"]
## Abilities
The Shy One has two unique abilities, one of which is a key mechanic that allows them to escape from the containment chamber.
[textlink="Learn more about abilities here." link="Scp096Abilities"]
